_comment: Canonical palette. Nothing else in this repo defines a hex value. Python reads it via src/palette.py; the dashboard reads theme/palette.css, which is generated from this file.

ramp._comment: Ordinal ramp: club gold into black, ranked by playlist volume. Key order IS rank order and is frozen on purpose - see 'why frozen' in src/palette.py. Dark values flip the anchor so visual weight always tracks volume.

residual._comment: Not ranks. Cool greys, deliberately off the warm gold scale so they cannot read as a sixth step.

categorical._comment: Peer categories with no ranking - match-cycle bins, scatter by subject. Validated adjacent-pair; same hex in both modes.

chrome._comment: Club colors for page furniture only - rules, headings, accents. Gold is 2.43:1 on a light surface and must never carry data as a categorical hue.
